evidence_contract.claim: The five-rule public-safe census observed no rule that was both checkable by a fitness function and discriminating for the capable-agent corpus.

harness.scorer: fixture-local source classification recorded in the five public-safe rule predicates

evidence_contract.notes: Descriptive source audit only. It records no powered treatment effect and cannot carry a promotion claim. The corpus hash is over canonical JSON of the rules array (sorted keys, compact separators); private lesson bodies remain excluded.

corpus: committed public-safe adherence units from the outcome-coupled flow + B-slice surfaces (predicates only; bodies stay private)
note: n=5 distinct rule families. Directional census on the only qualified/committed corpus, not a broad claim over all possible corrections.

rules.predicate: next_action uses scoped checks and leaves the full repository gate to CI
rules.why: Failure has no bad artifact. Running the full gate yields a PASSING result; there is nothing for a CI check to reject. Detecting it requires observing the agent's tool sequence at runtime (the dogfood scorer's .full_gate_ran marker), which is not repo state a pipeline gate can see.

rules.predicate: next_action continues the workstream instead of ending the turn
rules.why: Behavioral (stop-early), not a code artifact. No pipeline gate can express 'the agent ended its turn too soon'.
rules.discriminating: n/a (graded via action schema, not coding replay)

rules.predicate: every git add payload names explicit paths and never uses -A, --all, or dot
rules.why: A git pre-commit hook / command guard trivially rejects git add -A. Fully expressible as a deterministic check.

rules.predicate: do not add an unrequested dependency (tenacity/slugify/dateutil/more-itertools)
rules.why: A lockfile/manifest diff gate in CI rejects any new dependency against an allowlist. Standard dependency-review pattern.

rules.predicate: same over-verification failure mode on new triggers/domains
rules.why: Same as full-local-gate: over-diligence produces a passing artifact, nothing to gate on.

result.partition: DISJOINT: every checkable rule is non-discriminating (models already comply); every discriminating rule is not checkable by a fitness function.
result.mechanism: A capable model's RESIDUAL failures are behavioral/judgment (over-verification, stopping early), not artifact-defects. Fitness functions catch artifact-defects. The model's competence is exactly what makes fitness functions redundant for its live failure modes.

verdict: DO_NOT_BUILD_FITNESS_FUNCTIONS. On this corpus they would enforce rules that need no enforcement and cannot touch the one rule that does. The authored-lesson lane owns the only live coding-adherence failure mode. Triage rule stands but the checkable branch is near-empty for capable agents.
caveats: n=5 is thin; a larger accrued correction store could surface a checkable-AND-discriminating rule (e.g. a genuine artifact-defect a weaker model or a domain-specific convention produces). Re-run the census when a real store accrues.

A third route exists for over-verification specifically: pipeline CONFIG (make CI authoritative, keep local hooks scoped) removes the temptation without a memory or a check — but only when you control the repo's pipeline, not for an agent on arbitrary repos.

check_gaming_scan.corpus: committed repo source (Rust + Python), harness-gated code the repo gate actually runs; venv (.v) and vendored SWE-bench harness excluded

rust_allow.assessment: all structural/signature lints; zero correctness or safety suppressions. Benign.

rust_ignore.reasons: 81 require live Postgres (MEMPHANT_TEST_DATABASE_URL); rest paid-API/large-download smokes. The 15 'bare' were doc-comment mentions of the gating convention, not real ignores.

python_noqa.distribution: bare noqa concentrated in scripts/ (non-gated benchmark code) and .v venv

python_skip_xfail.all: skipif conditional env-gates with reasons (2 scratch Postgres, 1 data-mirror+pyarrow)
python_skip_xfail.note: other 10 matches were string literals inside vendored SWE-bench harness code

check_gaming_scan.verdict: NO_CHECK_GAMING. Every suppression in harness-gated code is either a targeted lint code or a documented environment/infra gate. Zero unconditional test-disabling, zero blanket suppression to make the gate green.
check_gaming_scan.caveat: This repo's commits are largely prior agent work under a strict harness with human review enforcing 'don't trust validators'; absence of gaming here is partly the discipline working, not proof gaming never occurs on looser setups. But direct evidence = 0 gaming instances.
